title: Salt Grass
shortDescription: Wind and pale grass, and no sheep.
longDescription:
The grass here is pale and sharp. Wind comes off the ditch and tastes faintly of iron. No sheep. No footprints worth a story.
North is the lintel field.

fixtures.name: Pale Grass
fixtures.lookDescription: Pale grass bent one way. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: Pale, coarse grass, every blade bent the same way toward the open moor, and it stays bent when you lift it. Kern says salt works into this pasture after a wet year and nothing grazes it. There are no droppings anywhere in the field.
